rationale: The FAA Exemption No. 19111B, dated September 18, 2023, explicitly states on PDF printed page 10, in its response to DAA safety-standard comments, that 'The exemption does not authorize the system.' This directly supports the claim that the exemption (operation-specific relief) is distinct from the authorization of the DAA system itself.
evidence_locators: FAA Exemption No. 19111B — Zipline International, Inc., PDF printed page 10, FAA response to DAA safety-standard comments
